mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 falls for three consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing and economic growth, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4% combined with a decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0 for 3 consecutive months AND PAYEMS falls for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS falls for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for 3 consecutive quarters AND HOUST falls for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 falls for three consecutive quarters and HOUST falls for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with a decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening manufacturing and economic growth, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for 3 consecutive months AND GDPC1 falls for 3 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls for three consecutive months and GDPC1 falls for three consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).
